goal: observe/stt-wer.fk tokenizes text into words with sw-tokens. Persian writes one word both with and without a zero-width non-joiner (U+200C, UTF-8 bytes 226 128 140) or a zero-width joiner (U+200D, bytes 226 128 141), so the same word is counted as two different words. Remove those two characters before tokenizing: add a new function (defn sw-drop-joiners (s) ...), with a helper loop of its own over the bytes of s that copies every byte except these two three-byte sequences, and change sw-tokens so it tokenizes (sw-drop-joiners text) instead of text. Leave sw-token-loop and every other definition exactly as they are; the new code is a new definition and a changed sw-tokens, nothing wrapped around existing code.
